Write line breaks as \n; the file's existing CRLF or LF line endings are matched and preserved. To change line endings themselves, make oldString and newString differ only in \r; that edit applies to the exact bytes. If there is no exact match, the edit retries while ignoring typographic quote, dash, and space variants, then trailing whitespace on each line. The edit fails if oldString is not found. By default, oldString must identify a UNIQUE location. Multiple matches FAIL unless replaceAll is true.
